condition: With SciPy 1.18.x linked against Apple Accelerate, scipy.linalg.cholesky(A, lower=True) on matrices with n >= 33 leaves garbage in the strict upper triangle, so the result is not lower-triangular and L @ L.T != A.
workaround: Apply np.tril() to the result. Alternatives are numpy.linalg.cholesky, scipy.linalg.lapack.dpotrf(A, lower=1), or calling cholesky(lower=False) and transposing.
